O profissional irá atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes técnicos de maior complexidade (N2 e N3) nos sistemas ERP e nas soluções de documentos fiscais eletrônicos da empresa, investigando causas, validando comportamentos do sistema e articulando soluções com as equipes técnicas. Principais responsabilidades:Assumir chamados escalados pelo suporte inicial, conduzindo atendimentos N2 e N3 que exijam investigação aprofundada de falhas em sistemas ERP, aplicações fiscais e integrações entre soluções. Investigar incidentes relacionados ao processamento, emissão, consulta e transmissão de documentos fiscais eletrônicos, identificando possíveis causas em parametrizações, regras de negócio, cadastros, comunicação entre sistemas ou serviços integrados. Reproduzir cenários reportados pelos clientes, analisar evidências, logs e mensagens de erro disponíveis e executar testes técnicos para diferenciar falhas de uso, configuração, integração, ambiente ou comportamento do software. Diagnosticar e solucionar ocorrências complexas em módulos e rotinas de ERP, considerando os impactos em processos como faturamento, cadastros, movimentações e rotinas administrativas, conforme o escopo dos produtos atendidos. Analisar falhas em integrações, troca de arquivos, comunicação entre aplicações e fluxos de dados, reunindo evidências técnicas e funcionais para direcionar a investigação e a correção. Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvimento, produto, implantação e demais áreas técnicas na análise de defeitos, inconsistências e incidentes que demandem correção, informando com clareza os testes realizados, o impacto e o comportamento esperado. Avaliar a abrangência e a criticidade dos incidentes, priorizando atendimentos conforme impacto nos processos dos clientes e risco de interrupção operacional, e acompanhar os casos até a validação da solução. Documentar diagnósticos, evidências, causa identificada, contorno aplicado e solução definitiva, transformando casos recorrentes em artigos técnicos e orientações que aumentem a autonomia do suporte e reduzam reincidências. Facilidade para investigar problemas e orientar usuários de diferentes níveis de conhecimento. Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou áreas afins. Experiências e conhecimentos desejáveis:Experiência com atendimento técnico em ambientes corporativos. Familiaridade com registro e gestão de chamados. Conhecimento de sistemas operacionais, aplicações empresariais e ferramentas de suporte. Experiência com atendimento remoto e acompanhamento de incidentes. Experiência em suporte técnico N2 e N3, com investigação de incidentes complexos e interação com equipes de desenvolvimento. Conhecimento de processos fiscais e contábeis, documentos fiscais eletrônicos e rotinas de sistemas ERP. Salário:A negociar. Own database availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational readiness for assigned production services. Perform detailed Oracle Database 19c performance analysis, tuning, and diagnostics using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, and operating-system- level diagnostics. Troubleshoot complex production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, implement permanent corrective actions, and improve operational runbooks and SOPs. Project long-range database capacity, lifecycle, and operational requirements in partnership with service owners across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem. Participate in an on-call rotation to support production database services. Strong experience with Oracle RAC, ASM, Grid Infrastructure, Oracle Data Guard,RMAN, database upgrades, and quarterly patching. Project long-range database capacity, lifecycle, and operational requirements in partnership with service owners across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem. The role focuses on practical Python automation, cloud deployment, data integration, monitoring and production support rather than AI model development or research. Agentic AI Implementation & Integration Support the implementation and integration of approved Agentic AI solutions within enterprise applications. Configure and maintain Python-based automation scripts and integration components used by Agentic AI workflows. By connecting global innovators with local expertise, Maha Asia is proud to be a green solutions provider in SEA — committed to helping manufacturers thrive through responsiveness, reliability, and the sustainable raw materials that will shape a healthier planet. Want to shape a greener and brighter future together? Our Vision “We will be the catalyst to a healthier planet” We envision a world where sustainable raw materials and green chemical solutions are the norm. By supplying specialty chemicals across Asia, we aim to foster an ecosystem that prioritizes environmental well-being and innovation. Why Join Maha? People-first Transformation: We believe the strength of our organisation lies in our people. That’s why we are transforming the way we work to empower our people to grow, contribute and make an impact. Regional Exposure: Across our 12 countries and 19 offices, our team members will have the opportunities to collaborate and learn from colleagues across Asia, gaining exposure to different markets, cultures and regional best practices. Collaborative Team: Collaboration at Maha goes beyond day-to-day teamwork. Our people actively connect, recognise one another and share knowledge through our regional group channels: #LivingTheValues – A space to recognise teammates who demonstrate our ATRIP values: Agility, Teamwork, Respectfulness, Integrity and Proactiveness. #SharingKnowledge – A space where colleagues share useful knowledge and ideas, from technology tips and sustainability practices to financial concepts and other learnings that can benefit teams across the region. About the Role: Develop, enhance, and maintain Odoo ERP functionalities, financial dashboards, and automation solutions to improve Finance operations, reporting accuracy, and process efficiency. Working closely with the Finance team, this role translates business requirements into practical technical solutions, reduces manual work, and strengthens data visibility to support better financial decision-making. What You’ll Be Doing: 1. Odoo ERP Development & Enhancement Develop, customize, and maintain Odoo ERP modules and functionalities, particularly those supporting Finance operations. Translate finance requirements into system enhancements, configurations, and technical solutions. Troubleshoot system issues, resolve bugs, and improve ERP performance and reliability. Support Odoo integrations with other business systems to ensure accurate and consistent data flow. 2. Financial Dashboard & Reporting Development Design, develop, and maintain interactive financial dashboards and management reporting tools. Automate financial data extraction, consolidation, and reporting from Odoo and other relevant systems. Work with Finance stakeholders to define reporting requirements, financial KPIs, and dashboard functionalities. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely availability for financial analysis and decision-making. 3. Finance Process Automation & Improvement Identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive Finance & Accounting processes. Develop automation tools, scripts, and workflows to improve efficiency and reduce human errors. Support improvements in financial processes such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, and month-end reporting. Integrate Odoo with relevant business applications, including Lark and other internal tools, where required. 4. System Integration & Data Management Develop and maintain APIs and system integrations to facilitate seamless data exchange. Support database management, data validation, and troubleshooting of data-related issues. Ensure data integrity and reliability across financial systems and reporting platforms. Maintain proper technical documentation, version control, and testing procedures. 5. Collaboration & System Support Partner closely with Finance users to understand operational challenges and recommend system improvements. Collaborate with BTI, external vendors, and relevant departments on system enhancements and integrations. Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and user guidance for finance-related systems. Support system upgrades, testing, implementation, and continuous improvements. What We’re Looking For: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. - Minimum 4–6 years of experience in software development, ERP development, or business systems automation. - Strong programming skills in Python, with knowledge of JavaScript and SQL. - Hands-on experience in Odoo ERP development, customization, or implementation is strongly preferred. - Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar tools. - Knowledge of API development, system integration, and database management. - Familiarity with financial processes such as AP, AR, GL, reconciliation, or financial reporting is an advantage. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. - Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with both finance and technical stakeholders.
